items.source: Sets whether to disallow DELETE requests on the endpoint.
items.translation: 设置是否禁止在该端点发出 DELETE 请求。

items.source:
Sets the McpJsonMapper to use for JSON serialization/deserialization of MCP
messages.
items.translation: 设置用于 MCP 消息 JSON 序列化/反序列化的 McpJsonMapper。

items.source: Sets the endpoint URI where clients should send their JSON-RPC messages.
items.translation: 设置客户端应发送其 JSON-RPC 消息的端点 URI。

items.source: Sets the security validator for validating HTTP requests.
items.translation: 设置用于验证 HTTP 请求的安全验证器。

items.translation: 用于创建WebMvcStreamableServerTransportProvider实例的构建器。

items.source:
Sets the context extractor that allows providing the MCP feature
implementations to inspect HTTP transport level metadata that was present at
HTTP request processing time.
items.translation: 设置上下文提取器，允许向 MCP 功能实现提供在 HTTP 请求处理期间存在的 HTTP 传输层元数据以供检查。

items.source: Sets the keep-alive interval for the transport.
items.translation: 设置传输的保活间隔。

items.source:
Sets the context extractor that allows providing the MCP feature
implementations to inspect HTTP transport level metadata that was present at
HTTP request processing time. This allows extracting custom headers and other
useful data for use during execution later on in the process.
items.translation: 设置上下文提取器，允许向 MCP 功能实现提供在 HTTP 请求处理期间存在的 HTTP 传输层元数据。这使得可以在后续执行过程中提取自定义标头和其他有用的数据。

items.source:
Sets the keep-alive interval for the transport. If set, a keep-alive scheduler
will be created to periodically check and send keep-alive messages to clients.
items.translation: 设置传输的保活间隔。如果设置了该值，将创建一个保活调度器，定期向客户端检查并发送保活消息。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if jsonMapper is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果 jsonMapper 为 null

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if mcpEndpoint is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果 mcpEndpoint 为 null

items.source: contextExtractor - The contextExtractor to fill in a McpTransportContext.
items.translation: contextExtractor - 用于填充 McpTransportContext 的 contextExtractor。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if contextExtractor is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果 contextExtractor 为 null

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if securityValidator is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果 securityValidator 为 null

items.source: IllegalStateException - if required parameters are not set
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果未设置必需参数

items.source: jsonMapper - The McpJsonMapper instance. Must not be null.
items.translation: jsonMapper - McpJsonMapper 实例。不能为 null。

items.source: mcpEndpoint - The MCP endpoint URI. Must not be null.
items.translation: mcpEndpoint - MCP 端点 URI。不得为 null。

items.source: disallowDelete - true to disallow DELETE requests, false otherwise
items.translation: disallowDelete - 设为 true 以禁止 DELETE 请求，否则为 false

items.source: keepAliveInterval - The interval duration for keep-alive messages, or null to disable keep-alive
items.translation: keepAliveInterval - 保持活动消息的间隔时长，或为 null 以禁用保持活动功能。

items.source: securityValidator - The security validator to use. Must not be null.
items.translation: securityValidator - 要使用的安全验证器，不能为 null。
